en: Colorized historic postcard showing a neoclassical building behind a central monument with an angel-like statue holding an object aloft. The monument stands on a pedestal accessed by steps, surrounded by gas-style street lamps and a small landscaped lawn. In the background are additional older buildings and trees. The printed captions at the bottom read "Valkhof." in the center and "NIJMEGEN." at the lower right.
